interface.longDescription: Autopilot AI search visibility tracking. Connect your own Apify account once, tell it your brand, website and any must-track keywords, and pick hourly, daily or weekly tracking; that one priced choice approves the plan. It then runs the baseline, draws charts after every run, recommends what to implement with step-by-step instructions, schedules tracking and remembers each project separately. When your Apify credits run out it pauses and tells you to upgrade or add credits. Eleven coordinated skills infer public business context, competitors, keywords and buyer questions and select research by goals, evidence and budget rather than running every Actor. Track AEO/GEO AI citations, sampled Google rankings, traffic estimates, keyword demand, Google Trends, backlink samples and qualified link opportunities. Save accessible reports, matching-panel comparisons, private context, corrections, feedback and action history for multiple websites within one portfolio ledger. Prepare briefs and review acknowledged work without promising causal ranking gains. Reuse capable user-owned Apify MCP/connector, secure API access or an independently installed official CLI; publisher credentials are never included. Optional existing authorized first-party data can enrich analysis. Recurring collection, digests and quiet alerts require supported verified scheduling, durable state and cost controls. The skills-only package includes no server, runtime, own MCP connection or publisher telemetry. Actor usage is billable; missing data remains unknown and results are sampled.
